mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ172. The user rushes forward with a sharp kick; on hit, a second kick launches the opponent backward, after which another technique can be used immediately. Current dedicated documentation describes an 11-hit presentation and notes that the move can chase evasive movement; exact startup and damage scaling remain unresolved.
